opening.argument: The offer is presented as a free $25 Fandango gift card, while access is directed through an external link. The page then requires an email, consent, and a Continue action, and its terms state that participation and purchases are required. The lower section further instructs viewers to complete offers to receive the reward, revealing a participation and purchase flow that conflicts with the uncomplicated “free” presentation. These conditions make the purported reward a low-barrier acquisition claim tied to additional requirements rather than an unconditional gift. The supplied frames do not establish who operates the page, whether the branding is authorized, what follows the Continue action, or whether the reward is ultimately provided.
